description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ulhitiyawa, Wennappuwa D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 410004
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Nos. 68, 95, and 96) with detailed property information including parcel numbers, extents, owner names, addresses, identity card numbers, title classes, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land ownership registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
